metadata.title: Encounters in the ONC - observing imprints of star-disc interactions

notes: No stars qualify. The paper's explicit unbound statements concern the ONC cluster itself ("seems to be gravitationally unbound", T:p5-b11) or stars escaping the ONC ("leave the cluster"/"escape from the cluster", T:p6-b18 and T:p8-b6), not present-day unboundness from the Milky Way. No supplied passage states or establishes a Galactic-unbound criterion satisfied by an individual star.
